name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Exactly two of (the members of the Joiners' Guild and Beatrix) go with (3 coins or 4 coins).
Fletcher goes with exactly one of Wulfric, 5 coins, or 7 coins.
Either Cedric goes with Potter, or Blacksmith goes with 7 coins — but not both.
Either Godfrey goes with Potter or someone in the Joiners' Guild goes with Godfrey.
Cedric, Blacksmith, and Fletcher go with 4 coins, 6 coins, and 7 coins, in some order.
The Fletcher's levy is between the Cooper and the Blacksmith.
If Blacksmith does not go with Aldric, then Wulfric does not go with Fletcher.

So Fletcher does not go with 5 coins.
